basic_info.description: First time on the market in over 50 years!A fantastic opportunity to make this unique and charming three unit Edwardian flat your own. Each full floor flat includes a flexible floor plan consisting of 6 rooms each and can be used as 3 bedroom/1 bath, or a 2 bedroom/1 bath, with a formal dining room. There is a separate porch and laundry room and may offer room to expand the kitchen or add an additional bathroom.  Classic period detailing with hardwood floors, crown molding, fireplace, and wainscoting. The property is located on a quaint and quiet street facing Park Presidio with plenty of off street parking. Conveniently located near Park Presidio, Lake Street Playground, Baker's Beach, Golden Gate Park, Clement and Geary Blvd amenities, and public transportation. Two units to be delivered VACANT at COE.  Great TIC partnership property!
